intro: Thailand is one of Southeast Asia's biggest economies, built on cars, electronics, farming and tourism.

chapters.title: Detroit of Asia
text: Thailand is a major car maker, especially pick-up trucks, for Japanese brands like Toyota. It also makes hard drives, electronics and rubber products.
It is one of the world's top exporters of rice, rubber, sugar and canned tuna.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Before 2020 almost 40 million tourists visited each year, and tourism is a huge employer. The 1997 Asian financial crisis began when Thailand's currency, the baht, collapsed.
